description: Public production benchmark for evidence-first, temporal, spatial, uncertainty-aware and bounded agentic research. Designed to test the capabilities most relevant to frontier-model and enterprise-AI platform partners without claiming AGI or independent certification.

cases.query: Assess the current evidence for commercial fusion energy. Separate established facts, recent signals, uncertainties, and the next checks that would change the conclusion.
Build an evidence-backed historical timeline of CRISPR from the early observations through modern therapeutic use, then explain the major turning points and remaining uncertainties.
Analyze CERN as a research institution: locate it using verified geographic evidence, provide a historical timeline, and explain how its location and international structure affected its development.

Compare retrieval-augmented generation and long-context model architectures for enterprise research systems. Produce a decomposed comparison, evidence, limitations, and a decision framework rather than a single winner.
Develop three testable product or research ideas for reducing hallucinations in enterprise AI research. Clearly separate proposals from facts and give an experiment that could falsify each idea.
Evaluate the claim that room-temperature ambient-pressure superconductivity has been experimentally established. Use evidence, distinguish claim from verification, and state what evidence is missing.

Explain the development of lithium-ion batteries as a combined history, materials-science and engineering problem. Include an evidence-backed timeline and develop two plausible next-generation research directions without presenting them as facts.

Yapay zeka araştırma sistemlerinde kaynak doğrulama, uzun dönem hafıza ve ajan otonomisi arasındaki dengeyi analiz et. Kanıtları, belirsizlikleri ve test edilebilir geliştirme fikirlerini ayrı göster.

Investigate how an evidence-first autonomous research agent should detect a weak answer and improve it safely. Provide evidence and concrete checks while avoiding any active intrusion or credential access.

Analyze the historical development of the European Organization for Nuclear Research as a temporal world-model problem: entities, relationships, dates, locations, evidence, uncertainty and two new research questions.
